title: Single generation of separable-predual finite factors
exact_target: Does every type $II_{1}$ factor with separable predual have one bounded operator x with $W*(x)=M$, equivalently two self-adjoint von Neumann generators? This asks for von Neumann generation and makes no norm-closed C*-generation assertion.

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
